# Main CPU base, E-PM2 1.6

Runtime address = block 0 offset + 0x7E421020; no edit lines up with the E-P7's 0x60020020 base.

**Category:** layout · **Address:** `0x7e421020` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-PM2 firmware 1.6, build 1600](../firmware/epm2-1600.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN E-PM2](../cameras/epm2.md)

Block 0 is 14,155,712 bytes of MN103 code under uITRON, not compressed. The base differs per TruePic VI body.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([EPM2Mod](../projects/epm2mod.md)): Base verified by disassembly of block 0. Source: [E-PM2 firmware format](../sources/epm2.format.md).
- **Physical camera** ([EPM2Mod](../projects/epm2mod.md)): Nine patch specs with new code placed with this base passed camera tests in the pinned build. Source: [E-PM2 feasibility and real limits](../sources/epm2.feasibility.md).
